source_reasoning.candidate_design: Run an explicit bounded attempt loop. Delay only between failures; return first success or preserve the last error.

source_reasoning.reference: Interpret scripted outcomes directly and construct the expected delay series.

numeric_semantics: Python arbitrary-precision integers; JavaScript BigInt for grid counts, prime products, rational ratings and order quantities. Other input numeric fields are safe integers.
unicode_semantics: Passwords use Unicode code points; board and remaining identifier/string domains follow the explicit ASCII/lowercase contracts.

assumptions.basis: Public group preview only; no exact variant body

assumptions.text: The native retry callable retries exceptions up to maxAttempts including the first call, invoking an injected delay hook between failed attempts with initialDelay*multiplier^i. Never sleep or perform I/O. The JSON adapter accepts scripted ok/error outcomes and returns value, error, attempts and delays; exhausted scripts raise exhausted.
